verses.tasiru-wara-a-l-hubbi-u-jubatu-l-kawni-c: tasīru warāʾa l-ḥubbi ʾuʿjūbatu l-kawni tuṭālibuhu bil-ʿayni min laḥẓaḍi l-ʿayni
faqālat walaw la l-ḥubbu la yaṣilu mruʾu ʾilā llāhi law qādathu ʾuʿjūbatu l-kawni
wal-kawni ʾāyātu wafyihā dalaʾilu wal-kawni mā lil-kawni min ʿajabi yughnī
walakinna sirra l-ḥubbi khāṣṣu biʾahlihi wakullu muḥibbi yafhamu sh-shaʾana bish-shaʾani
fala tasʾalan ʿammā yazīduka ḥayrata wala tasʾalan ʿan dhāka bil-kayfi wal-ʾayni
taḍāyaqati l-ʾasbābu lammā tasāʾalat ʾaḥaqqā yuqāsu l-ḥubbu bil-maddi wal-wazni
falaysa bimaddi ʾaw biwazni waʾinnamā yuqāsu bimā fī l-khuldi ʾamnā ʿalā ʾamni
wamā zīnatu l-ʾashyāʾi ʾila taṣawwuru ṭarāʾifuhā kal-ḥubbi fī jannati ʿadni
waman lam yadhuq mā fīhi min qabli nashʾahi fakayfa ʿalā l-ʾaḥbābi yuthnī wayastathnī
yamurru bibābi l-muṣṭafā wahwa lam yakun liyaʿrifa ʾanna l-bāba min ḥubbihi yudnī
wal-hi fī taʾadībihi ramzu ḥubbihi wal-muṣṭafā min baʿdu mā rāqa min ḥusni
ʿalā ḥubbihi yabnī riḍā wataqarrubā wakāna ʿaẓīmā man ʿalā ḥubbihi yabnī
wafī ḥubbihi kal-fanni mā ʾaʿjaba l-warā faʾayyada ʾanna l-ḥubba ʾarqā mina l-fanni
hawāʾu laṭīfu la yudannisuhu hawā wakullu shuʿūri fīhi nūru ʿalā ʿayni
biḥikmahi man la yaʿrifu n-nāsu khalqahu walaw mayyazū l-ʾabʿāḍa bil-jinsi wallawni
faman la yuqawwī bil-yaqīni ḥayātahu faʾayyāmuhu tazdādu wahnā ʿalā wahni
wafī ḥubbi khayri l-ʿālamīna wiqāyatu waqānā bihi l-bārī ʾadhā l-ʾinsi wal-jinni
